title.zh-TW: `gh pr edit` 指定審核者，不用每次都先抓一輪組織團隊名單
title.en: `gh pr edit` no longer fetches your org's whole team list just to add a reviewer

body.zh-TW: 你用 `gh pr edit` 幫一份 PR（pull request，你送出等人審核、準備合併的一份程式碼修改）指定審核者，如果只是加某個人，不是加某個團隊，以前這個指令還是會先跑去組織裡把整份團隊名單抓一遍，不管你用不用得到。⟦就像去檔案庫辦事，只有真的要用到某份檔案才去調閱它，不會每次進門都先把整個檔案庫翻一遍。⟧現在 `gh pr edit` 只有你真的要指定某個團隊當審核者時，才會去抓這份名單，其餘情況直接跳過這一步。對你來說，差別在於單純加個人當審核者的操作，不會再被一趟用不到的名單查詢拖慢。
body.en: You use `gh pr edit` to set reviewers on a PR — a pull request, the code change you've submitted and are waiting on someone to review before it merges. Add just one person, not a team, and until now the command would still go fetch your entire org's team list first, whether you needed it or not. ⟦It's like visiting an archive: you only pull a specific record when you actually need it, you don't flip through the whole archive every time you walk in the door.⟧ Now `gh pr edit` only fetches that list when you're actually naming a team as a reviewer, and skips the step the rest of the time. For you, that means adding a single person as a reviewer no longer gets slowed down by a team lookup you never needed.

items.original: `gh pr edit`: Only fetch org teams for reviewers when required by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11835

title.zh-TW: 快取筆數、轉圈指示器、派工倉庫、登入通道，四處小毛病一次修好
title.en: Cache delete counts, the spinner, task-dispatch repo, and login — four small fixes at once

body.zh-TW: 這幾個小毛病都出在不會特別留意的地方。清快取（cache，算過的結果先存著、下次直接拿）時，`gh cache delete` 回報的刪除筆數以前會算錯。不管你只給 key，還是 key 再加上 ref（git 參照，標出這份快取屬於哪個分支），現在數字都對得上。`gh agent-task create` 加 `--follow` 看進度，以前跑完那個轉圈指示器不會自己停，現在結束就跟著收掉。同樣是這個指令，以前派工可能送到上游倉庫（upstream repo，你這份倉庫的來源），而不是你設定的預設倉庫，現在會送對。另外，`auth login` 與 `auth refresh` 改走 UNIX socket（同一台電腦裡程式互傳資料的通道，不繞網路）。⟦像搬完家才發現的幾件小事：箱數少算了、玄關燈忘了關、一封信還寄到舊地址、電話線也沒接上新插孔，這次一併收拾。⟧
body.en: These are the kind of small bugs you'd never notice unless you hit them directly. When you clear the cache — results stored earlier so you don't have to recompute them — `gh cache delete` used to report the wrong number of deleted entries; now the count is right whether you pass just a key or a key plus a ref, the git reference marking which branch a cache entry belongs to. Run `gh agent-task create` with `--follow` to watch progress, and the spinner used to keep spinning after the run finished; now it stops right when the task does. That same command used to sometimes dispatch work to the upstream repo — the repo yours was forked from — instead of your configured default repo; now it goes to the right one. And `auth login` and `auth refresh` now talk over a UNIX socket instead of the network. ⟦It's like the handful of things you only notice after you've finished moving house: you miscounted the boxes, forgot to turn off the hallway light, a letter still went to the old address, and the phone line never got hooked up to the new jack — this round cleans up all four.⟧

items.original:
fix(cache delete): report correct deleted count for key and key+ref deletions by @luxass in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11838
`gh agent-task create`: Fix `--follow` not killing the progress indicator by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11879
`gh agent-task create`: Fix targetting upstream instead of default repo by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11896
Fix `auth login` and `auth refresh` to use UNIX socket by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11922
